preclose_proxy_minus_night.note: paired per signal over signals CLOSED in both streams (A = preclose_proxy, B = night): positive = buying at the signal-session close beat the next-day order. R uses each stream's own planned risk (entry_ref - stop); A$ is at the fixed stake

preclose_proxy_minus_night_per_signal.note: per SIGNAL seen, A$ at the fixed stake (A = preclose_proxy, B = night); a signal a stream did not trade (next-day order unfilled / gapped past its limit, or stop >= close) counts A$0 for it. stake.rules: owner's sizing model: the same A$ stake on EVERY recommended order (no max-2/day beyond what was published, no 25%-of-equity cap, no cash constraint), shares = floor(stake / net fill price), additive P&L (no compounding), net of brokerage both sides + 1 tick slippage per side. n / totals = CLOSED trades; open positions are in n_open / open_pnl_aud_mtm (marked at the last close, both brokerages deducted), not in the totals. peak_capital_aud = max positions open on the same session (entry..exit session inclusive) x stake; return_on_peak_capital = total_pnl_aud / peak_capital_aud. pnl_curve = cumulative realised P&L by exit session, one point per exit session (null for untracked policies, to keep the file small).
